name: heyanon-mcp
description: Wallets, portfolios, DeFi and CEX actions through Anon, the HeyAnon on-chain agent; Gemma crypto research; token transfers and scheduled automations. Includes an Agent Skill that teaches wallet selection, self-contained Anon requests, background-task polling and confirmation rules. All account tools need a HeyAnon API key from https://heyanon.ai/.

HEYANON_API_KEY.title: HeyAnon API key
HEYANON_API_KEY.description: Create it at https://heyanon.ai/ (account settings, API keys). It is sent only as the X-API-Key header of the MCP connection and never through the chat.
